g.text: Generated from commerce_binding.ttl: 4 sources, 74 concept bindings, 576 property bindings. Core terms (grey) come from commerce_core.ttl.
1. Binding model: the general-purpose cb: vocabulary
Every source is described with these classes; adding a store adds instances, never new concepts. Arrows: object properties (0..1 = functional, * = many). Hollow triangle = subclass.
2. Coverage: which table holds each core concept in each source
⊂ = only rows matching a filter (e.g. qty < 0) · (virtual) = no table, one implied instance · — = the source cannot provide the concept
3. Worked example: how each source supplies the properties of cc:Order
column or SQL expression [value format] · join → target table · lookup by natural key · code mapping · constant
